definition: בְּאֻשִׁים noun [masculine] plural stinking or worthless things , wild grapes (Late Hebrew noun of individual meaning בְּאוּשָׁה ) (perhaps adjective omitted עֲנָבִים compare Di ) Isa 5:2 ; Isa 5:4 of Yahweh's vineyard, Vulgae labruscae (see further De ).
